# Modernization register

The single source of truth for the TracePoint modernization program. Edit the JSON fragments in
[`register/`](register/), then run `node scripts/modernization-register.mjs`. Field definitions and
the status rules are in [`register/SCHEMA.md`](register/SCHEMA.md).

Source keys: **OA** Operational audit, 2026-10-20 (docs/operational-audit-20261020) · **UX** UI/UX audit, 2026-10-22 (docs/uiux-audit-20261022) · **SV** Authenticated staging validation (uiux-audit reconciliation/register-SV, handoff SV-xx) · **VR** TracePoint Visual Review (sources/visual-review) · **WR** TracePoint Intuitive Workflow & Usability Review (sources/workflow-review) · **BP** Unified UI/UX Modernization Blueprint v2 (sources/blueprint-v2) · **REM** Operational remediation branches (UX-RB, B-, F-, DC-batches)

### MOD-DS-002 · Replace AppearanceStyleOverrides class-rewriting with token-driven theming

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Screen | TracePointShell appearance (balanced, high-contrast, accent) |
| Category · track · priority | functional · A · P0 · R1 |
| Owner | claude |
| Sources | UX:A-03, UX:A-04, UX:A-05, UX:A-06, UX:README §3.1, UX:H-F12, UX:README §4.1 Colour semantics |
| Requirement | Agency appearance (brightness, contrast, accent) is applied by setting CSS variables on the shell root instead of [class*=…] !important overrides, so hover variants are never matched, translucent surfaces keep their opacity, the accent never recolors status colors, and the accent is applied before first paint. |
| Acceptance | 1. With balanced and high-contrast brightness, the computed background of an inactive nav link differs from the active link (component/visual test). 2. A unit test asserts no theming selector matches hover:, group-hover: or other variant classes. 3. Translucent slate surfaces (e.g. bg-slate-900/70) keep their opacity under every appearance mode. 4. The emerald accent does not change success/status colors, and the slate accent does not make primary buttons look disabled. 5. No hydration mismatch warning and no accent flash on first paint (accent set via cookie or pre-hydration script). |
| Dependencies | MOD-DS-001 |
| Implementation | — |
| Evidence | — |
| Status | **Not Started** · staging Not released · production Not released |
| Disposition | Open |

### MOD-DS-012 · AsyncState: loading is a skeleton, failure is 'Couldn't load · Retry', never a false all-clear

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Screen | All data screens |
| Category · track · priority | functional · A · P0 · R1 |
| Owner | claude |
| Sources | BP:§1 Dashboards & data, BP:§4 Foundations (AsyncState), BP:§5 Stage 2 coordination, BP:§6 Screens sometimes overstate, UX:README §5 #7, UX:README §4.2 EmptyState/Skeleton/ErrorState, UX:remediation-plan WP-2 LoadState, SV:SV-05, SV:SV-06, SV:SV-15 |

The error/empty contracts from SV-05, SV-06 and SV-15 are used unchanged. 4. Module instances (B-24, B-40, B-63, C-26, C-37, C-53, D-28) are fixed by their modules using this component. |

No control on the screen discards unsynced work; unsynced scores survive a reload (§1b, UX-RB-5 design). |

### MOD-SET-001 · One save model per Rules Engine panel

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Screen | /settings → Rules Engine (all sub-tabs) |
| Category · track · priority | workflow · B · P0 |
| Owner | claude |
| Sources | UX:E-04, UX:E-33, SV:SV-29, OA:§4 Save patterns, BP:#14, WR:Workflow measurements: Admin · change a module rule, WR:Module scorecard: Settings & Rules |
| Requirement | Each Rules Engine sub-tab has exactly one save control that names what it saves and saves only that panel. The header "Save Rules Engine" is removed or shown only on sub-tabs whose content is the parent rules object. All rules panels share one RulesPanelShell (dirty state, Save, Reset, inline status), replacing the seven panel-local feedback variants. Panels that write immediately (Secure Storage) are marked "Saves immediately" and have no Save button. |
| Acceptance | 1. On the Certifications, Equipment, Off-Duty, Agency Training and Fleet sub-tabs no header Save is offered; each panel's own Save persists that panel and a reload shows the saved values. 2. On Firearms/Range sub-tabs the remaining Save is labelled with its scope and persists only the parent rules (component test). 3. SV-29 reproduction (change Off-Duty rules, save, reload) shows the change persisted and a visible confirmation. 4. Every rules panel renders through the shared RulesPanelShell (one feedback style, one Save/Reset layout). 5. Save status is server-confirmed: success is shown only after the server confirms the write, and failures are shown in place (§1b). 6. Audit writes are unchanged: the same actions write the same audit entries with the same fields as on the baseline (§1b). |
| Dependencies | MOD-SET-002, MOD-SET-004 |
| Implementation | — |
| Evidence | — |
| Status | **Not Started** · staging Not released · production Not released |
| Disposition | Open |
| Notes | WP-5 (UX remediation plan). SV-29 confirmed live on staging 22e543d. Save semantics (what each endpoint writes) are unchanged; only which button calls which existing endpoint changes. |

Sign-out still posts through the Cognito hosted logout and revokes the session server-side exactly as today (§1b). |
